result.prior_version_note: Before February 2, 2026, landlords could add an extra percentage increase for utilities on top of the allowable annual RSO increase, and could add a 10% increase when a dependent was added to the tenancy (D041, D042). Separately, RSO rent increases were prohibited from March 30, 2020 through January 31, 2024 (D041). The documents do not state the RSO's original effective date.
